title: The RF-185 Live timing test passes under machine load
acceptance: The 200 ms wall-clock assertion in LiveMode.test.tsx (RF-185) uses a fake clock or a bound that holds under load, and still fails if the double start it guards returns.

evidence.summary: Reported by the RF-136 agent during its local gate for #768: one failure under heavy load, pass on a full rerun. Other suites also needed reruns under the same load (web UI 5 s timeouts, an integration worker RPC timeout) during #767's gate.

RF-243 (Backlog, P3) names LiveMode's RF-185 timing test (316 ms against a 200 ms limit) in its title and acceptance, which asks for a pass under heavy load without weakening what the test checks. The assertion is still wall-clock on main cd92e49: apps/web/src/components/LiveMode.test.tsx line 3455, expect(performance.now() - tappedAt).toBeLessThan(200). The owner chose "Clear ones only (Recommended)" in the live triage session, 2026-11-24, which cancels RF-225 as a duplicate of RF-243.

resolution: Duplicate of RF-243, which names the same LiveMode RF-185 timing test (316 ms against its 200 ms limit) among the tests that run close to their limit under machine load, and asks for a reliable pass without weakening what each test checks. Cancelled under the owner's prune decision of 2026-11-24 ("Clear ones only (Recommended)": "web RF-225 (dup of RF-243)").
